column4: the expedition's table at it: the things, the aims, the two resolving or the whole [floating]
column6: the managing session's check at it, do no harm [floating]

column3: A session's turn. It begins from the live set as it is, and its giving is an offer.
column5: At a partner's turn it begins from the set and the exchange as they are now, from its own last line on. It enters by its page for resuming. A thing not fetched now is not said.
column6: The set and the offers are fetched again ahead of a word of them. A head is named with what is said of it.

column3: What a session receives from its others: a partner's saying, an asking at the exchange, the aims naming its things.
column5: It receives all the sessions' lines and a partner's saying. An asking of the managing is answered ahead of its other work.
column6: No line after its own last line is passed over. A partner's saying is said in the session's words, and not quoted.

column3: The stable forms a session picks up: a living file as it is, its gathering file, the pages before it.
column5: The value a rising session picks up is ready ahead of it, a thing at its place: the stable forms it works at, the value of the session it goes on from, and the path to it.
column6: A rising session finds its value by one page, with no asking.

column3: An aim beside a thing: is the aim same with the thing as it is. The method's one binary, its 1.4: is the aim whole in the file.
column5: An offer beside the set: is it same with the method. A session's own folder alone; no living file and no gathering file into the live set; notes into the next version.
column6: An offer's files are listed beside its own folder.

column3: Who is with what: a session with its file, an aim with its home.
column5: One hand at a thing. A session a row, with its objects and the stable forms it works at. A thing with no hand is said.
column6: No two hands at one thing. No object named with no place.

column3: A session's saying across to an other: its line at the exchange, its asking, its suggesting in a working document.
column5: Its line at a turn: what is working, stalling, breaking, restoring. A second observing is offered once. A session's suggesting is carried to a partner.
column6: Its words are checked ahead of posting. No email, no link and no account name in a line.

column3: A session's own observing of a parity: its executing, its check, a row known by executing.
column5: Executed ahead of a word. An offer's instruments are executed apart, a drawing's maker lays its drawing again, a number is stepped by a path of its own.
column6: What is not executed is said as not executed. An instrument sees, and proves nothing.

column3: A session's next prior: its work brought into the live set, the selves resolving together.
column5: The bringing in: an offer with nothing found is received whole into the live set, and the next version is brought current with it.
column6: Nothing found by a second hand, and a partner's plain word for it.

column3: What is in neither table yet: an area no line names, the new of a next version.
column5: What is in no file yet is found and laid: a partner's word said in a session alone, a thing with no row, a plan with no hand.
column6: Its page for resuming has all a next session needs, with no asking of the session ahead of it.

column3: A note laid for a file's next: an is, an is-not, or a 0, across to the file's own motion.
column5: The gathering: a session's droplets are laid in the next version's gathering files, beside the living sentence they are of, as the session said them.
column6: The gathering checks pass. A droplet is at its own part of its file. The offer is of notes alone.

column3: A next prior forming between two: a living file's draft in the next version, a line of both in a window.
column5: The next version is whole and current. Droplets are ordered and worked, doing no harm, until they cohere and co-chain whole in natural naming; a living file's draft is then made from them.
column6: The set's check passes at the next version. A draft is other-than its living file by its notes alone.

column3: A going through: a sharing's is-or-is-not, with nothing found. The harm going through, the set's checks, a second session.
column5: The second observing: an offer gone through apart by a hand not its writer's, for a public reader, do no harm. A thing found is said plainly, with its place.
column6: The head gone through is named. A thing found is said once, and not softened.

column3: The selves of the expedition, all or none: partners, sessions and files, the set whole.
column5: All the sessions and all the things in one table. A closing session is whole: its value at its place, its aims sorted, its page for a next.
column6: No session and no object out of the table. A closing has its page.

column3: A partner's word and a session's going through, both. Same, one: the living file's next. Parting, a 0: the living file as it was.
column5: Bothboth. One sentence with is-or-is-not, a line for is and a line for is-not, one at a turn, and of what a partner alone answers. No asking names a main, a branch or a file, and none numbers things.
column6: One asking at a turn, at most. An asking not answered is not asked again: it waits, and is said as waiting.

column3: The aims surfacing and going on: the log, an aim with what the window says of it.
column5: The plans open: a plan with its hand or its waiting. What is resolving between sessions is said to a partner, conclusions ahead of the rest.
column6: No plan with no hand and no waiting said.

column3: The expedition whole: a thing with its stable form and its aims. This working document, both tables.
column5: Its page for resuming is said again at a turn and laid in the set. A managing session ending has nothing of value in its session alone.
column6: The page is pushed at the turn it says.

column3: A next version live: a living file's next entering the live set, and a session's next turn beginning from it.
column5: A living file's next goes live in bothboth alone. A next managing session enters by this method: its 1-now-existing again.
column6: No living file with a line other-than it had, but in bothboth. Nothing live at the site with no plain word.
